title: OL-20261121-1: Four keyless superseded GitHub Apps stay installed
body:
**Owner:** tick-worker
**Trigger:** daily app-audit row
**Done check:** file:ops/connections/github-apps.json
**Status:** closed

APP-INVENTORY-1: the tick step app-audit prunes extra installations of the two active apps and records credential_events app-audit. The four superseded apps hold no key, so only the owning account's GitHub settings can remove them (identity-bound); default in effect: installed and inert. Session: session_0156nqDv6NMcEmv9wqYJK3XS

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T10:41:05Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 8.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-21T18:25:57Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: file:ops/connections/github-apps.json
